optimization.certification: Numerical success is not evidence. Reconstruct at the fixed one-million denominator limit, scale the primal to its exact minimum payoff, scale the dual downward to exact feasibility, and verify every state and leg inequality using fractions. A nonzero gap is an interval, not proof of exact optimality.
optimization.decision: Complete priced population plus exact dual lower bound >=1 rejects strict gross covers only in the retained conditional proxy system. Exact primal cost <1 is an exploratory witness only. Otherwise remain inconclusive. Missing prices never become zero.
optimization.dual: Find y_s>=0 with sum(A_sj*y_s)<=c_j for every priced leg; sum(y_s) is a lower bound for every feasible long-only fractional cover in that exact proxy system.
optimization.price_sources: First outcome native bestAsk; second outcome 1-bestBid rejection proxy. Missing fields and zero acquisition quotes remain missing; outcomePrices are never consulted. No current fee, fill, depth, capacity or executable-rate claim.
optimization.primal: Minimize sum(c_j*w_j), w_j>=0, with sum(A_sj*w_j)>=1 for every score or common cancellation state.

payoff_model.claims: First team score >=T, combined score >=T, favored-team score difference >=D, and winner with exact one-half actual-tie payout. Second outcomes are complements. Common whole-game cancellation pays one half on every outcome.
payoff_model.coordinates: Nonnegative integer final scores x,y for the same complete game; no empirical maximum score or outcome probability.
payoff_model.finite_representatives: T is the maximum admitted scalar threshold, D is at least one and the maximum admitted absolute margin threshold; B=T+D+2. Every nonnegative integer score maps into [0,B]^2 preserving all scalar, margin, tie and complement payoffs. Include common cancellation separately, then deduplicate payoff vectors before prices.
payoff_model.unqualified: Independent condition disputes, partial voids, actual oracle/collateral identity and interpretation of full-game score references are not proved by the model. A conditional rule-consistent floor is not a universally guaranteed venue payout.

population: All 78 previously inventoried native full-game markets of the four declared kinds on the original selected event; no sibling or inactive-row substitution. This is a new joint allocation calculation, not another two-total-pair test.
question: Does any nonnegative fractional portfolio of every retained full-game moneyline, spread, team-total and total outcome cover one common payoff unit at a strict sub-unit side-specific proxy cost?
selection_history: The consumed complete two-total pair screen and its best 1.04 unit cost were already known. New team/spread joint prices have not been consulted in this method phase. This is retrospective exploratory reuse, never independent validation.
stopping: One read of retained economic fields after a successful exact-rule preflight. Rule, precision, solver, reconstruction, storage or certificate failure is terminal; do not refit, narrow, reprice or change precision after access. No book, fee, account, credential, order or fresh observation authority follows even from a positive witness. Preserve all earlier results and the consumed native population.
